name: Jidapterus
isnote: Also recovered in Tapejaridae (Chaoyangopterinae) by Pinheiro et al. (2011).
sum: Toothless chaoyangopterid with a straight, pointed beak, from the Jiufotang Formation of Chaoyang, Liaoning.
material: Nearly complete skeleton with partial skull.
biology: Chaoyangopterids are thought to have been crane-like terrestrial foragers.
author: Dong et al. 2003
